ScrollViewSlider = Object:SubClass("ScrollViewSlider")

ScrollViewSlider.sr = nil
ScrollViewSlider.slidingThreshold = 150
ScrollViewSlider.offSetMouseX = 0
ScrollViewSlider.index = 1;
ScrollViewSlider.totalCount = 0;
ScrollViewSlider.speed = 0.2;

function ScrollViewSlider.Init(self, sr, totalCount)
    self.sr = sr
    self.totalCount = totalCount
end 

-- 下一页
function ScrollViewSlider.NextPage(self)
    self.index = self.index + 1
    if self.index > self.totalCount then
        self.index = self.totalCount
    end
end

function ScrollViewSlider.LastPage(self)
    self.index = self.index - 1
    if self.index < 1 then
        self.index = 1
    end
end
